name: Sengoku If
source:
Sengoku era.  
Main character is born in the family of a powerful daimyo. During his ceremony of coming of age father gets killed putting protagonist in the head of the family. He is guided by his uncle, but there is no more time to waste. Chaos of war approaches this province. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
战国时代。
主人公出生于一个强大大名的家族。在他的元服仪式上，父亲遭人杀害，主人公因而成为家主。叔父从旁指导他，但已经没有时间可以浪费，战争的混乱正向这片领地逼近。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
